# gowaku widget catalog

[日本語](../ja/README.md) · [Searchable site](https://bankai-tensei.github.io/gowaku/catalog/)

The public widgets of gowaku in 119 entries by category. The pictures are drawn by `gpu/soft`, the CPU renderer, and switch between light and dark with the reader's settings. Each example is the code that drew its picture, kept in `internal/catalog`, where it compiles.

> The text in the pictures is English: they use only the Go fonts, to be drawn the same on every machine, and the Go fonts have no Japanese glyphs. See [docs/catalog/README.md](../README.md).

The lower-case functions in the examples (`themed`, `colored`, `tile`, and shapes such as `squareIcon`) are small helpers in [internal/catalog/helpers.go](../../../internal/catalog/helpers.go); `themed` is a `basic.Builder` that reads `basic.ThemeOf(ctx)`. `core.Widget` and `core.BuildContext` in the examples are the same types as `gowaku.Widget` and `gowaku.BuildContext`.

## Packages

The widgets live in packages by layer ([ADR 0081](../../ADR/0081-widget-layers.md), in Japanese); each layer imports only the ones below it. Entries are named with their package: `control.Button` is `Button` of `widgets/control`. Two packages may have types of the same name.

| Package | Contents |
|---|---|
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/basic) | The theme, boxes and layout, effects and transforms, implicit animation, text and images, scrolling. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/interact) | What takes input: gestures, the mouse, focus, shortcuts, drag and drop and semantics. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/control`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/control) | Controls with a look of their own: buttons, checks, sliders, tabs, split panes and progress. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/overlay`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/overlay) | What floats above the page: dialogs, sheets, toasts, tooltips and menus. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/field`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/field) | What takes a value by typing or picking: text fields, search, forms, dropdowns, dates and times. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/nav`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/nav) | What moves between pages and places: the Navigator, heroes, the back button, breadcrumbs, tab bars and toolbars. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/collection`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/collection) | What shows many items: lists, trees, tables and property grids. |
| [`github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/editor`](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/bankai-tensei/gowaku/widgets/editor) | The editor of long documents. |
